device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC satellite receiver with CA card reader and Ethernet / Wi-Fi
device.soc: ALi C3505 (the maincode's "ALI_C3505:0x%x" chip-id print, seecode "M3505 SEE")

simulator.note: Boots as the C3505 family (chips/c3505.py): its boot-ROM bootloader at offset 0x800 sets $sp to the uncached boot-SRAM view 0xBFE04000 (0x3C1DBFE0 at 0x804), waits for bit 8 of 0xB8000300, unpacks the 9.6 MB maincode into RAM and starts it.  The application starts the SEE co-processor program ("M3505 SEE") at 0xA6000200 on the second core (see.SeeCore), prints "ALI_C3505:0x1004f", drives the FD650K front panel on GPIO 107 / 110, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 "System Setup" OSD menu (21 GE commands, 146 unique colours) through the display engine layer at 0xB8006900.

desc: Ferguson Ariva 104 official firmware V1.3B1 (2020-07-30 revision) from ferguson-digital.eu for the H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi C3505 SoC.
